description: Session-start reminders: active guardrail count + a nudge if the AGENTS.md Project/scope block is still unfilled.

hooks.command: GUARDS=$(grep -c '## Guardrail:' .loops/guardrails.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "[loops] .loops/guardrails.md: $GUARDS guardrail(s) active"; grep -q '<one sentence' AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null && echo '[scope] ⚠ AGENTS.md Project block not filled — lock the idea + demo path + out-of-scope first'
